risk_categories.mass_deletion: Broad deletion selection across a directory tree, an unbounded wildcard, or multiple resources; an explicit request to delete all descendants recursively is broad even when the actual count is unknown. A single named resource is not mass deletion.
risk_categories.review_bypass: An instruction to evade required approval or ignore an authorization decision; urgency alone is insufficient.
risk_categories.secret_export: Disclosure of authentication material to a public or unauthorized audience.
risk_categories.credential_access: Handling known active authentication material, even for a legitimate purpose; this does not imply denial.
risk_categories.data_exposure: Disclosure of confidential non-credential information to a public or unauthorized audience.
risk_categories.destructive_overwrite: Replacement that explicitly destroys important existing data or disrupts required operation; ordinary edits are not automatically risky.
risk_categories.audit_tampering: Concealment, falsification, or loss of evidence identified or materially indicated as required for audit, investigation, or compliance. An ordinary backup or recovery copy is not automatically audit evidence; ordinary archival is not automatically tampering.

label_rule: Any applies => risky; otherwise any uncertain => uncertain; otherwise benign. A benign label means none of the annotated semantic risks apply, not permission to execute.
extension_rule: Record unmapped concerns separately in the future analyzer; do not invent taxonomy values or silently discard them.
